_comment: Keycloak identity-provider broker to Okta (or any OIDC IdP, incl. Auth0). POST to /admin/realms/<realm>/identity-provider/instances. Create an OIDC web app in Okta; sign-in redirect URI = <KC>/realms/<realm>/broker/okta/endpoint. Replace <<PLACEHOLDERS>> (Okta domain like dev-123.okta.com). useJwksUrl lets Keycloak discover signing keys.
